difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe whose total space is smooth over the base has a smooth structure morphism (author lemma at source lines 7727-7732, label lemma-gerbe-smooth). The proof (source lines 7734-7745) combines the known surjectivity flatness and finite presentation of a gerbe morphism with the descent statement for smoothness, reduces to a quotient presentation by the local structure lemma and applies the smoothness result for quotients (proof lines 7734-7744). The reduction to the quotient case is the substance. H3.
